app.name: Wringy
app.tagline: Content rewards for verified eligible views.
app.demoBadgeDetail: Every record, amount, time and message on this page is simulated. No Google, email or payment request is made.

shell.opsActive: Acting as {role}. Operations identities exist only in the demo tools.
shell.signedOutToast: Signed out of the simulated identity.

state.emptyDescription: When there is something to show it appears here. This is demo data.
state.errorDescription: The demo could not read this. Nothing was changed. Try again.
state.forbiddenDescription: You do not have access to this workspace in the demo. This is a simulated check, not production authorisation.
state.unavailableDescription: The source could not be read. The last trusted value is shown with its time. Unknown does not mean zero.

money.serviceFeeValue: Pending configuration · not charged in demo

views.definition: Qualified views are plays verified against the campaign rules. They are not raw plays, unique people, orders or sales.

budget.title: Reward pool
budget.note: The four amounts always add up to the pool.
budget.paidMeaning: Paid means funds are available in the simulated provider account. Bank settlement is a separate fact.

confirm.reasonPlaceholder: Write the reason that will be recorded.
confirm.demoNote: This action is simulated and recorded in the demo only.

email.previewDescription: The demo does not send email. This is what the message would say.
email.subject: Subject

reset.title: Reset demo data
reset.description: This returns every demo record to the baseline. Only demo records are stored, and only in this browser.
reset.done: Demo data reset to the baseline.
reset.needsResetTitle: Saved demo data could not be read
reset.needsResetDescription: The stored demo data does not match this version and was not used. The baseline is shown instead. Reset to clear the stored copy.
reset.storageBlockedTitle: Demo data cannot be saved in this browser
reset.storageBlockedDescription: Local storage is unavailable, so the demo works but does not keep progress after a refresh. The language switcher still works; the preference is not saved.

localePrompt.title: Which language would you prefer?
localePrompt.description: You can change this anytime in Settings.
localePrompt.draftNote: Malay and Chinese copy is a draft awaiting professional review.

errors.forbidden: This identity is not allowed to do that in the demo.
errors.invalid_input: Check the values and try again.
errors.not_signed_in: Sign in to the simulated identity first.
errors.campaign_not_ready: The campaign is not ready: funding evidence or data source is missing.
errors.campaign_not_open: The campaign is not open for this action.
errors.min_claim_above_cap: The minimum claim cannot be higher than the cap per submission.
errors.unsupported_platform: That platform is not part of this campaign.
errors.duplicate_post: That post is already submitted to this campaign.
errors.cross_campaign_blocked: That post is already used in another campaign.
errors.pending_claim_exists: A claim for this submission is already pending. Wait for it to be reviewed.
errors.below_min_claim: The new claimable amount is below the minimum claim.
errors.view_threshold_not_met: The campaign view threshold is not met yet.
errors.nothing_claimable: There is nothing new to claim.
errors.data_unavailable: The source data could not be read, so this cannot be confirmed now.
errors.offer_stale: The budget changed, so the offer must be reconfirmed.
errors.offer_amount_mismatch: The amount does not match the offer. Reconfirm the exact amount.
errors.appeal_already_filed: An appeal was already filed for this claim.
errors.release_not_allowed: The reservation cannot be released yet.
errors.attempt_unresolved: The earlier payout attempt is unresolved. Reconcile it first.
errors.retry_not_allowed: A retry needs a confirmed failure first.
errors.invalid_transition: That change is not allowed from the current state.
